system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 4 hours, 15 Spell Uses. Lasts: Indefinitely. The target explodes in blood, guts and viscera; casting gradually raises the pain until it is unbearable. Great for torture, not good for drapes and carpets. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
